headline: Water Commission Approves TIG Report on Lahainā Water Permits

meeting.body: Water Commission Approves TIG Report on Lahainā Water Permits
meeting.summary: The board unanimously approved a TIG report on water use permit applications in the Lahaina surface and groundwater management area.
meeting.recap: The board took up the TIG report on water use permit applications in the Lahaina surface and groundwater management area.[[0:00:00]] The chair said the TIG presented its report to the board at the last meeting.[[0:00:11]] The chair said the board would vote to approve the report so it can be sent to CWRM.[[0:00:16]] No one signed up to testify on this item.[[0:00:25]] The chair closed testimony at 2:24 p.m.[[0:00:40]] A board member moved to approve the TIG report, and another member seconded the motion.[[0:00:57]] The chair thanked the group for the work and research behind the report.[[0:01:39]] One member said the report is meant to help the public in Maui understand the water permit process.[[0:02:07]] The member said the process is very complicated, even for an expert in water.[[0:02:27]] The member said the report is meant as a reference for the board and the public as permitting goes forward.[[0:02:49]] The member said the permit process is just the beginning and is only partially complete.[[0:02:58]] The member said it will take attention over years, maybe decades, to fix some poor planning from the past.[[0:03:15]] Members voted by raising hands, and the chair said the vote was unanimous and the motion passed.[[0:03:55]]
meeting.next: The approved report is to be sent to CWRM.

moments.q: Motion to approve the TIG report
"It's only partially complete. It's just the beginning and there's a lot more to it."
The vote: "It's unanimous. Uh, motion passes."
